$comment: Every version this image depends on, pinned in one place.
sandbox.sdkVersion MUST equal the @cloudflare/sandbox version the Worker package depends on:
the container server inside the base image and the SDK in the Worker speak a versioned protocol,
and a mismatch shows up as an opaque exec failure at runtime rather than a build error.
imageDigest pins the exact base manifest; imageRef is the human-readable equivalent.
